# Mukunda Infraventures & Projects Pvt. Ltd.

> Plot developer in Nagpur, part of the Mukund Group. Residential plotted
> layouts and the Karmabhoomi industrial estate on Bhandara Road.

## Projects

- Karmabhoomi, Mahalgaon, Bhandara Road - 40 acres - industrial plots only - MahaRERA P50500055060
- Ayodhya, Tarodi - 10 acres - residential plots - MahaRERA P50500079303
- Mukunda Keshavam City 9, Wagdhara, Hingna - residential plots - MahaRERA P50500054443
- Mukunda Keshavam City 10, Wagdhara, Hingna - residential plots - registration applied for
- Vraj, Jamtha - residential plots - registration applied for
- Dwarka, Sumthana - residential plots - registration applied for
- Mukunda Keshavam City 7 - sold out
- Govardhan, Khasarmari - upcoming

Plot sizes and other project facts are on each project page. Verify any
registration number on the MahaRERA portal: https://maharera.maharashtra.gov.in/

## What we offer

Residential plotted layouts and industrial plots, each approved for its own
use. Karmabhoomi offers industrial plots only, not built sheds. Amenities are
listed per project on its page.
